lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the central flank, becoming more compressed as the lines approach the shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the posterior, splitting in the upper quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line and the final three anterior lines near the neck are truncated, failing to reach the ventral or dorsal boundaries of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the rear haunch, located inferior to the first three vertical lines.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a pair of spots below the eyes and a white patch on the lower throat. Distinct white bands are visible on the distal limbs just above the hooves.
